input.free_text_description: The system operates in the e-commerce, authentication domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include cart, category, category page. Core business data revolves around Cart, OrderMain, ProductCategory, ProductInOrder. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to add items to a shopping cart and check out, so that I can conveniently collect items before purchasing.
As a API Consumer, I want to organize items into categories, so that users can easily navigate and filter available items.
As a API Consumer, I want to log into the system, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and features.
As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
